nodes.label: Conductor scoreboard (absolute SWE-style scores)
nodes.rationale: Score = resolution rate over the frozen suite (hidden F2P turns green, fixture P2P stays green). Runs are independent: benchmark a config alone and compare against published rows.

nodes.label: Suite-hash comparability contract
nodes.rationale: Only rows sharing a suite fingerprint are comparable; stale-suite rows predate a suite change and must be marked, otherwise history silently invites false comparisons.

nodes.label: Read the Engaged column before the headline
nodes.rationale: A cell scores 0 both when the skill ran and got the change wrong and when it never ran at all. base-sonnet5-high reads 2/5 (40%) but engaged only 2/5 and resolved 2/2 of what it attempted — every failure in that row is non-engagement, so nothing in it supports 'worse at the work'.

nodes.label: Minimum detectable effect ~20pp
nodes.rationale: The suite is ~7 cells at --runs 1, so n≈7 per arm and only ~20pp differences are detectable; ~10pp would need ~293 observations per arm. Overlapping Wilson intervals mean 'not distinguished yet', not 'equal'.

nodes.label: Null control: benchmark the same config twice
nodes.rationale: The pair measures the harness, not the model: if two identical-config rows differ materially, the harness is the noise source and any A-vs-B gap smaller than that spread is unreadable.

nodes.label: † engagement assumed, not measured
nodes.rationale: Rows built with --cells from .grade files written when only ENGAGED cells produced one: a non-engaged cell left no grade, never entered the denominator, and its non-engagement is structurally invisible. F2P tests is pooled, so non-engaged cells contribute 0/0 and vanish from it too.

nodes.label: No usable cross-model engagement comparison exists
nodes.rationale: The obvious comparator base-opus48-1m-high is a † row (5/5 assumed by construction); the only measured opus arm differs in effort as well as model, so it is confounded — and even at face value 4/5 vs 2/5 is Fisher-exact p=0.52 at n=5.

nodes.label: swe-run.mjs (scorecard producer)
nodes.rationale: Produces a scoreboard row with --name/--model/--effort/--plugin-dir/--runs, and now writes a grade record for every cell carrying its measured engaged flag.

nodes.label: Quality beyond correctness stays pairwise
nodes.rationale: Style, coverage and thoroughness are not in the absolute score; they live in arena's judge layer and are compared among resolved runs only.
